The rest of the story is as to how the teddy bear and Aditya head to Hong Kong to save the body of Pallavi.  The film is an adaptation of the Tamil film "Teddy".

Less than a few hours later, the BIVD (Supernatural Intelligence and Security Service) arrives at his door. Issam, along with the top eight gamers in the world, including his idol, Ripvis, must battle through five real-life game levels to defeat the AI.
